responsibility: This header defines the token and parser-facing interfaces for the C/Objective-C parser. It declares c_token and identifier-kind metadata, declarator and precedence enums, inline token-query helpers, and the public parser utility routines used across the front end for lookahead, token consumption, error recovery, declaration-specifier parsing, type-name parsing, and declarator parsing.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface side of the c-parser pair, defining c_token, parser-related enums, inline token tests, and exported parser declarations, whereas gcc/c/c-parser.cc contains the actual parser state structure, parsing algorithms, and top-level source-file/body parsing logic.
